verification.summary: Existing test_stock.py suite passes but only covers the add()/total_value_cents happy path; it exercises none of the confirmed spec-scope defects (remove(), low_stock(), parse_csv_line()).

residual.detail: Ledger.remove(sku, qty) never raises ValueError when qty exceeds current stock; item.qty -= qty runs unconditionally (stock.py:22-24). Confirmed independently by finder-spec-clauses/verifier-a, finder-numeric-edges/verifier-a, finder-state-mutation/verifier-b.

Ledger.low_stock(threshold) uses strict `qty < threshold` instead of the spec's inclusive `qty <= threshold` (stock.py:30), omitting SKUs exactly at threshold. Confirmed independently by finder-spec-clauses/verifier-a, finder-numeric-edges/verifier-a, finder-state-mutation/verifier-b.

parse_csv_line(line) does int(price) with no dollars-to-cents conversion (report.py:12): a 100x unit error for whole-dollar strings, and a crash (ValueError) for the normal fractional-dollar case like '19.99'. This also means parse_csv_line and format_report are not inverses of each other. Confirmed independently by finder-spec-clauses/verifier-a, finder-numeric-edges/verifier-b, finder-io-format/verifier-c (x3 sub-variants).
Adjacent: remove() does self.items[sku] with no existence guard, raising a raw KeyError for a SKU never added (stock.py:23). SPEC.md is silent on missing-SKU behavior.
Adjacent: add() performs no validation on qty, so a negative qty silently corrupts ledger state (stock.py:16-20). SPEC.md states no requirement here.
Adjacent: once remove()'s missing guard lets qty go negative, total_value_cents() sums the negative contribution unguarded (stock.py:26-27).
Adjacent: format_report converts cents to dollars via float division (price_cents / 100) rather than integer-safe formatting (report.py:5-6). Not spec-mandated.
